headline: ADP Nonfarm Employment Change matches previous figure, defying forecasts
summary: The ADP Nonfarm Employment Change matched the previous period's figure, defying economist forecasts.
why: Private employment reports serve as leading indicators for the monthly US jobs report and overall labor market health.
